question: If tantheta=(12)/(13) then find the value of (2sintheta costheta)/(cos²theta -sin²theta )
solution:
**GIVEN:**

tanθ = 12 / 13

**FORMULA USED:**

tanθ = sinθ / cosθ

2sinθ × cosθ = sin2θ

cos²θ - sin²θ = cos2θ

**SOLUTION:**

⇒ 2sinθ × cosθ / cos2θ - sin2θ = sin2θ / cos2θ

⇒ sin2θ / cos2θ = tan2θ

⇒ tan2θ = 2tanθ / 1 - tan²θ

⇒ 2tanθ / 1 - tan2θ = (2× frac{12)/(13)}{1-((12)/(13))²}

⇒ (24times 169)/(13(169 - 144))

⇒ 312 / 25

Hence option 3 is the valid answer.
